# Miqyas (مقياس)

> Miqyas is an independent lab that tests open-weight AI models for Arabic: dialects, deployment reliability and local performance. A leaderboard tells you how a model scored; Miqyas tells you what happens when you try to use it. Site in Arabic, with English notes.

- Job Trials put a model through a real job (for example a clinic front desk over WhatsApp, in Gulf Arabic) and report whether it can do it, for which sub-task, on which hardware.
- Protocols are committed to git before any run; raw outputs are published in full; numbers that were not measured are marked as not measured.
- Quick Trials are exploratory and carry no verdict.
- Independence: Miqyas never accepts cash from a lab whose models it tests; any other support (credits, hardware, services) is disclosed with its source. Policy: https://miqyaslab.com/%D8%A7%D9%84%D8%A7%D8%B3%D8%AA%D9%82%D9%84%D8%A7%D9%84%D9%8A%D8%A9/
- Data and code: MIT licence. Repository: https://github.com/Miqyas-Lab/job-trials

## Studies

- [All trials](https://miqyaslab.com/%D8%A7%D9%84%D8%AA%D8%AC%D8%A7%D8%B1%D8%A8/): every published trial, newest first
- [Job Trial #1: clinic front desk](https://miqyaslab.com/findings/frontdesk-v2/): open Arabic models as a clinic receptionist, every conversation published
- [Tool-calling back-fill for four models](https://miqyaslab.com/findings/bf01-adapter-backfill/): the two ways of calling tools, compared on the same job
- [Quick Trial: ALLaM 7B](https://miqyaslab.com/findings/qt01-allam-7b/)
- [Quick Trial: Falcon-H1 7B](https://miqyaslab.com/findings/qt02-falcon-h1-7b/)
- [Quick Trial: Fanar 2 27B](https://miqyaslab.com/findings/qt03-fanar-2-27b/)
- [Quick Trial: SILMA 9B](https://miqyaslab.com/findings/qt04-silma-9b/)
- [Quick Trial: Inkling 2 Mini](https://miqyaslab.com/findings/qt05-inkling-2-mini/): tested as promised; the publisher does not claim Arabic support
- [The Arabic token tax](https://miqyaslab.com/findings/token-tax/): how many more tokens the same sentence costs in Arabic, per tokenizer
